name: Promenade
desc:
Customer Success Associate | $22/hr plus up to $10K annual bonus | Phone, Email, and Social Media Support, No Sales Expectations
Company: Promenade (formerly BloomNation)
Industry: Customer Service

What Your Day Will Look Like:
Promenade makes software that helps local businesses like florists, restaurants, meat and seafood shops, pet stores, and liquor stores sell online and keep their customers. In this entry-level role, you're the main contact between Promenade and the florists and small businesses that use their platform, plus their customers. You'll handle a high volume of support requests by email, phone, and social media, figure out what's wrong, and send bugs to the engineering team when needed. You'll also help customers and partners get the most out of the software and point out patterns that could make support better. Expect to learn tools like Zendesk, Salesforce, and Confluence.

Soft Skills
- Friendly, caring communication
- Staying calm and positive under pressure
- Problem solving
- Relationship building
- Quick learner with new tech
assessment: expect an assessment but no mention of one
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed in the posting
Required Experience: None strictly required. This is an entry-level role.
Preferred Experience: Customer service or customer support by phone, email, or chat. Retail or service industry experience is a big plus.

Required Skills:
- Excellent communication in writing and on the phone
- Tech savvy and quick to learn tools like Zendesk, Salesforce, and Confluence
- Natural people person and relationship builder
- Friendly, optimistic, and caring
- Works well under pressure and tight deadlines
- Interest in helping small businesses

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has retail, restaurant, or service industry experience and wants a remote support job
- Enjoys helping small business owners
- Picks up new software quickly
- Wants a growing company with a bonus and stock options

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Wants a slow-paced or scripted job
- Isn't comfortable writing lots of emails and messages
- Gets flustered handling many requests at once
- Prefers not to learn new technology
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Customer support
- Customer success
- Phone, email, and social media support
- Zendesk
- Salesforce
- Troubleshooting and triage
- Bug escalation
- Small business support
- Relationship building
- High-volume support

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your customer service experience and the channels you've used, like phone, email, or chat.
- How would you help a florist who says orders aren't coming through on their website?
- How do you stay calm and positive when you have a lot of requests waiting?
- Tell us about a time you turned an unhappy customer into a happy one. What was the problem, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you noticed a problem in a process and helped fix it. What did you notice, what did you do, and what changed?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $22/hr plus a $10K annual bonus, paid quarterly. If the full bonus is earned, that works out to about $26.80/hr total.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage.
-Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision; stock options and 401(k); PTO, paid sick days, paid holidays, and paid parental leave; monthly credits for Lyft, Uber, and Metro.
-Equipment Provided: Yes. The posting lists company gear including a MacBook Pro.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: This is great pay for an entry-level role, and the bonus adds a lot on top. The posting lists the job as remote, but Promenade is based in Santa Monica, CA, and some perks like catered lunches and paid parking are for the office. Participants should confirm in the screen which states can work remotely. Promenade may use AI tools to help review applications. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Customer Success Associate → Senior Customer Success Associate → Customer Success Manager → Partner or Account Manager. This role builds software support, account relationship, and troubleshooting skills.
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
